item.description: This mod adds a beautifully designed, immersive, and user-friendly interface for xSkills.

item.description: XLib provides an interface to add skills, abilities and effects to the game.

item.description: deathmarkers for frontier map

item.description: A simple SheyderMod that supports the original artstyle of the game.

item.description: Collection of patches for a personal server.

item.description: Simple patch to the Racial Equality mod that allows a wider range of height options.

item.description: Crown that attracts all nearby items
